items.question: How long does SEO take to show results?
items.answer: The first signs usually appear within 6 to 12 weeks, depending on your site's condition and the competition. The impact on leads and orders takes longer.

items.question: How do I know the work is actually being done?
items.answer: You receive an implementation log showing what was done and when, plus a performance dashboard connected to your Search Console and Google Analytics accounts.

items.question: Does your SEO service include content and link building?
items.answer: It depends on the agreed scope. The work can be limited to technical SEO and on-page work, or it can also cover content and links.

items.question: Do you work with online stores?
items.answer: Yes. We have a dedicated track for category and product pages on Salla, Zid, Shopify and WooCommerce.

items.question: Do I need a developer?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We implement most improvements ourselves on popular platforms; on custom-built systems, we'll need your developer's cooperation.

items.question: Do you require long-term contracts?
items.answer: We work month to month. We recommend at least six months to see a clear impact, but we don't lock you into a long contract.

sections.heading: Want to know which plan fits your site?
sections.text: Your plan depends on the size of your site, the competition and how much hands-on implementation is needed. You can review the plan details before booking a call.
